Guess the time saved: 5 small business tasks before and after AI

We timed one invented cleaning business through a normal week. Rough numbers, including the time to read and fix every draft.

Biggest win: a week of social posts, about 45 min down to about 10. The prompt:

"Write 5 short Instagram posts for this week for [BUSINESS], a [TYPE OF BUSINESS] in [CITY]. One each: a tip, behind the scenes, a customer question answered, a team shoutout, a reminder to book. Under 50 words each. Friendly, plain, max 3 hashtags."

Smallest win: checking who hasn't paid. No change at all. AI can't see your invoices, and bank details don't belong in a chat. Use your invoicing tool's filter.

Always check the facts: it guessed that clients leave a key.

Follow @nomorebusywork and comment PACK: I'll DM you 21 more prompts for your business.
